usage_rules: Use 'background.DEFAULT' (#FDFCF8) for the main app background to reduce eye strain (Warm Paper).
Use 'background.paper' (#FFFFFF) for cards, drawers, and active input areas.
Primary color (#335C67) is for Main Actions (Save, Confirm) and Active States.
Secondary color (#E09F3E) is for Highlights and 'Today' indicators in the calendar.
Status colors must be used sparingly for appointment states (Confirmed=Success, Cancelled=Error, Pending=Warning).

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Use 'text.primary' on 'background.DEFAULT'.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring: 'focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#335C67]/20'.
accessibility.aria_labels: Calendar navigation buttons must have aria-labels (e.g., 'Next Month').

media.image_style: Images should be warm, professional, and use soft lighting. Avoid sterile blue medical stock photos.
media.icons: Use 'Lucide React' icons. Stroke width: 1.5px. Color: 'text.secondary' by default, 'primary' for active states.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION PRIORITY: 1. Calendar (The Core), 2. Patient Drawer, 3. SOAP Notes.
THEME: 'Clinical Organic'. It must feel like a high-end notebook, not a spreadsheet.
CALENDAR: This is the 'Eje Principal'. It must be robust. Use 'react-big-calendar' or a custom grid. Do not use a tiny date-picker as the main view.
SOAP NOTES: Design this as a 'Distraction Free' writing mode. Use a clean textarea with 'Public Sans' font.
DRAWER: Use the 'Sheet' component from Shadcn for the 'Drawer lateral'. It allows the doctor to view the calendar while editing a patient.
LANGUAGE: All UI text must be in SPANISH (e.g., 'Agenda', 'Pacientes', 'Expediente', 'Guardar').
RESPONSIVE: The calendar must stack gracefully on mobile (switch to Day view automatically).
DATA-TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to every button, input, and link. Format: 'page-section-element' (e.g., 'dashboard-calendar-next-btn').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects sparingly (only for sticky headers/overlays).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
